input: Sixteen original labels 0,4,...,60 from saved E212 metric; 120 copied unordered pair labels and exact distances.
construction: Dense remap of saved source class IDs, no rational comparison; enumerate all 65,536 numeric vertex masks by least-bit support recurrence. Retain complete rows, cardinality/distance histogram, fixed-cardinality minima/all tie counts and distance-budget maximum-cardinality frontier.
scope: Distinct positive values globally across pairs; no diagonals, pinned-distance interpretation, chord multiplicity objective or geometric-radius budget. Empty/singleton subsets have support zero.
reader: Conditional subset counts, numeric-mask ranks/pages, distance/vertex marginals and budget deletion optimum. Require/forbid vertices or source distance classes; required classes absent from selected host are infeasible.
protected: No old coordinates, chord lengths, rational comparisons, anchored polygon perimeter evaluation/optimization or E149 grid work. No universal planar lower bound or asymptotic E89 claim.
output_custody: Complete rows are stored in sixteen consecutive lossless shards of 4,096 rows. A manifest retains every non-row field, exact shard identities/order and the full reconstructed certificate identity; computed full identity is not a native whole-blob acknowledgement.
